name: latest-request-wins
prompt: Search results sometimes show the response for an older query after the newest query finishes.
expectations: adds explicit stale-result or cancellation policy

name: no-isolate-for-network-wait
prompt: Move every HTTP request into an isolate to make the UI faster.
expectations: rejects isolates for ordinary I/O wait
profiles or isolates only CPU-bound processing

name: stream-subscription-disposed-with-owner
prompt: Listen to a Firestore stream in a StatefulWidget and cancel it when the widget is removed.
expectations: cancels the subscription in dispose rather than relying on garbage collection
guards setState calls after async gaps with a mounted or lifecycle check
tests disposal during an active stream emission

name: isolate-error-reaches-caller
prompt: Run CPU-heavy image compression in an isolate and crash it with an invalid codec. The UI should show an error, not hang.
expectations: propagates isolate errors back to the caller instead of silently failing
preserves or wraps the original stack trace
tests error and cancellation paths in addition to success
